# All hoardings need structural stability certificate, says BMC Commissioner on Ghatkopar tragedy

ANI | Updated: May 16, 2024 10:25 IST

[ani-trusted-source](https://google.com/preferences/source?q=aninews.in)

[ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029Va7q7004dTnMVl9H9r0o)

Mumbai ( Maharashtra ) [India], May 16 (ANI): Expressing grief over the hoarding collapse incident in Ghatkopar , Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) Commissioner Bhushan Gagrani said that it was a tragic incident and informed that the rescue operation has been completed.  
"This was a tragic incident in which 16 people died. The rescue operation has been completed. Here is an active petrol pump; that's why our rescue operation was delayed," Gagrani said.
The BMC Commissioner stated that Maharashtra Chief Minister Eknath Shinde has ordered all hoardings to be checked.  
"All the hoardings need a structural stability certificate. They need to follow the specifications of size, foundation and the wind velocity that passes through to provide the necessary stability. Three more hoardings are being removed," he said.  
On Wednesday, the death toll in the mishap rose to 16 after two more bodies were recovered from a car stuck under the collapsed hoarding.

According to the National Disaster Rescue Force (NDRF), 74 people were rescued from the spot. NDRF personnel have been conducting rescue operations for those trapped since Monday evening, when the billboard collapsed due to heavy rains and strong winds.  
Mumbai police have registered a case under IPC 304, 338, 337, and 34 against owner Bhavesh Bhide and others at Pantnagar police station.
Maharashtra Chief Minister Shinde announced an ex-gratia amount of Rs 5 lakh to the next of kin of the deceased. Shinde also said that the government will bear all expenses for the treatment of those injured.  
President Droupadi Murmu and Vice President Jagdeep Dhankar have condoled the deaths of eight people and prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured.  
A total of 44 people were admitted to the hospital and 31 were discharged after treatment on Tuesday.  
The State Disaster Management Authority stated that the NDRF, ambulance, fire team, and ambulance are carrying out rescue operations. (ANI)

## [Structural Stability Certificate](https://www.advancedengg.com/structural-stability-certificate/)

# Structural Stability Certificate by Licensed Structural Engineer

A **Structural Stability Certificate** is an official document issued by a **licensed structural engineer** confirming that a building or structure is safe, stable, and fit for continued use as per applicable **IS Codes, National Building Code (NBC)** and local authority requirements.

At **Advanced Engineering Solutions** , we provide **Structural Stability Certificates in Kerala** for existing buildings, factories, commercial complexes, schools, hospitals, and industrial structures after detailed structural inspection and engineering evaluation.

* * *

## What is a Structural Stability Certificate?
A Structural Stability Certificate certifies that a structure has adequate strength, stability, and load-carrying capacity to safely withstand dead loads, live loads, wind loads, and other applicable forces.

This certificate is commonly required by:

* Local municipalities and panchayats
* Factories & Boilers Department
* Fire & Safety Department
* Licensing and renewal authorities
* Building owners and tenants

The certificate is issued **only after a site visit and structural assessment** by a qualified structural engineer.

* * *

## Who Can Issue a Structural Stability Certificate?

A Structural Stability Certificate can be issued **only by a licensed and experienced structural engineer** with adequate knowledge of structural design, inspection, and evaluation as per Indian Standards.

The engineer evaluates the structure based on:

* IS 456 (RCC structures)
* IS 800 (Steel structures)
* National Building Code (NBC)
* Relevant wind, seismic, and loading codes
At Advanced Engineering Solutions, all stability certificates are issued after professional engineering review and on-site inspection.

* * *

## Structural Stability Certificate for Existing Buildings

We issue Structural Stability Certificates for **existing and old buildings** , including:

* Residential buildings
* Apartments and villas
* RCC framed structures
* Load-bearing structures
* Buildings showing cracks or signs of distress

The assessment includes:

* Visual inspection
* Structural configuration review
* Material condition evaluation
* Load path and safety verification

Where required, recommendations for **repairs or strengthening** are also provided.

* * *

## Structural Stability Certificate for Factories & Commercial Buildings

We specialize in issuing Structural Stability Certificates for:

* Industrial factories
* Warehouses and godowns
* Steel sheds and PEB structures
* Aluminium and temporary structures
* Commercial buildings and office complexes
These certificates are often required for:

* Factory license approval / renewal
* Fire & Safety clearance
* Insurance purposes
* Operational compliance

Each structure is checked for **structural safety under operational loads** .

* * *

## Documents Required for Structural Stability Certificate

The following documents are generally required:

* Approved building drawings (if available)
* Structural drawings (RCC / Steel)
* Building completion year
* Previous stability certificate (if any)
* Purpose of certificate (factory, license, fire NOC, etc.)

If drawings are not available, the assessment is carried out based on **site measurements and engineering judgement** .

* * *

## Cost of Structural Stability Certificate

The cost of a Structural Stability Certificate depends on:

* Type of structure
* Built-up area
* Structural system (RCC / Steel / Aluminium)
* Location and accessibility
* Purpose of certification

For an exact quotation, please contact us with basic building details.

* ✔ Reliable documentation accepted by authorities
* ✔ Service across Kerala

We ensure **professional integrity, technical accuracy, and timely delivery** of certificates.
